B0: Observed last-four-calendar-week component means; source-bound position/role priors when absent; common coherence/distribution engine
B1: Four-observation shrunk volume means; numerator/denominator rates shrunk with twenty opportunity equivalents; weekly means for targets without a validated opportunity exposure
priors: Historical plus completed current-season outcomes grouped by canonical position and lagged opportunity role; fallback to position then entity family
historical_role_assignment: Prior four calendar weeks only; never the target row
participation_model: Shrunk probability of a nonzero credited-stat week using fully source-observed activity/zero weeks; separate conditional production; explicitly a stat-activity proxy, not a calibrated medical probability
sleeper_actual_target_use: Explicit historical actual stat keys may reconcile provider-defined specialist scoring; omitted keys stay unknown unless an independent event/zero certificate closes them
negative_certificate_policy: Completed game, full source fields and absence of every qualifying event; retain unknown candidate games
player_absence_zero_policy: Completed game/whole-week source audit, exact roster membership, no published stats, and no canonical PBP actor occurrence; never roster status alone
count_distribution: Poisson, fractional-sack half-count support; fitted nonnegative count means
yard_distribution: Signed normal conditional on observed opportunity, fitted empirical scale; no-opportunity gives zero; rare direct yards use an empirical hurdle with validated zero and nonzero exposures
conditional_counts: Binomial rates within parent attempts/completions/receptions/TD counts
joint_model_limitations: Entity-level marginal sampling and accounting constraints, without a calibrated NFL-wide team/game covariance or team yard/TD budget model
B0_output_interpretation: Raw rolling mean parameters are preserved; issued component expectations are Monte Carlo means after the common participation and accounting constraints
injury_policy: Current Out is carried to first target week only; IR/PUP/reserve labels may be carried as a declared three-week availability assumption; later recovery probabilities are not invented
team_membership_policy: Observed cutoff membership held fixed through three targets; no future transfer knowledge
calendar_byes: Exact zero prediction from fresh scheduled calendar; all event probabilities zero
source_window_limitations: Masked outcome availability can bias priors; support counts and source-proxy flags must be exported
C4_first_write: Immutable issuance and raw observation bundle; retries verify bytes; revisions use new directories
C4_publication: Archive on a separate research branch; receipt bound to immutable remote commit and hashes; no app/champion promotion
